notes.title: We're Live!
notes.notes: Thanks for your input and patience. RadianVR is now out of Early Access. Special thanks to early adopters. Now let's get those high scores cooking!

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, happy to announce that a big update is now available!

- Flow tweaks, including more dying blocks earlier in the game
- Fixes for puzzles that we temporarily unavailable
- A real UI for puzzles, with "star" count and replayability
- Visual improivements
- Major performance improvements
- Full high score implementation
- More options and adjustments for VR and non-VR play modes
- Improvements to randomized music system, with more variation
- Better keyboard and mouse control in non-VR mode

Have fun!
